title: Spectra — Fourier Lab
description: A nine-mode interactive Fourier lab on a from-scratch FFT — now it doesn't just show the transform, it puts it to work. Draw shapes redrawn by rotating vectors, build and HEAR spectra, filter noise in the frequency domain, read spectrograms, compare a Morlet wavelet against the STFT, paint masks over a real 2-D image FFT, TIME-STRETCH and PITCH-SHIFT audio with a phase vocoder, compress images with a from-scratch JPEG-lite DCT codec, and pull pitch from formants with the cepstrum. Deep-linkable; no math libraries.
